description: Variation of condition 2 (compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission 25/01244, to allow the replacement of approved drawings with proposed drawings showing design revisions for: amendments at lower ground floor including infill extension at rear elevation and side lightwell; metal framed glass sliding doors to master bedroom; modifications to landscaping to accommodate infill extension; external black painted metal spiral staircase to access upper ground terrace from garden; casement window reduced in size and fenestration modified; and amendments at upper ground floor including: rear terrace adjusted to suit infill extension at lower ground floor; black painted metal railing adjusted to suit size of terrace; rear doors from kitchen to be replaced with bi-fold doors in a white painted timber finish; the addition of 2no. rooflights; and, a new green roof and planting above lower ground floor flat roof and garage.
